TanStack Router useNavigate.description:
Navigate programmatically; the returned promise resolves once the navigation settles. Requires useNavigate from @tanstack/react-router.

以编程方式导航，返回的 promise 在导航完成后 resolve；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 useNavigate。

TanStack Router useNavigate with params.description:
Navigate to a route with a dynamic segment. Requires useNavigate from @tanstack/react-router.

导航到带动态段的路由；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 useNavigate。

TanStack Router Navigate.description:
Navigate on render. Prefer a redirect thrown from beforeLoad — it runs before the component mounts. Requires Navigate from @tanstack/react-router.

渲染时导航；更推荐在 beforeLoad 中抛出 redirect，它在组件挂载前就会执行；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 Navigate。

TanStack Router redirect.description:
Redirect from beforeLoad or a loader by throwing. Carrying the current href in search lets the target send the visitor back. Requires redirect from @tanstack/react-router.

在 beforeLoad 或 loader 中通过抛出实现重定向；把当前 href 带在 search 里，目标页便可将访问者送回；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 redirect。

TanStack Router useBlocker.description:
Block navigation while a condition holds and resolve it yourself; render a confirmation when status is 'blocked', then call proceed or reset. Requires useBlocker from @tanstack/react-router.

在条件成立时拦截导航并自行决定去留：status 为 'blocked' 时渲染确认界面，再调用 proceed 或 reset；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 useBlocker。

TanStack Router useRouterState pending.description:
Read router state with a selector so the component only re-renders when the selected value changes. Requires useRouterState from @tanstack/react-router.

通过 selector 读取 router 状态，仅在所选值变化时重渲染；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 useRouterState。

TanStack Router useCanGoBack.description:
Go back only when this application produced the previous entry, and fall back to a known route otherwise. Requires useRouter and useCanGoBack from @tanstack/react-router.

仅当上一条历史记录由本应用产生时才后退，否则回退到已知路由；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 useRouter 与 useCanGoBack。
